Toddle is an AI-powered teaching and learning platform for K–12 schools. Built by educators, for educators, it is used by over 200,000 educators across 2,500+ schools in 100+ countries. Teachers today work 50+ hours a week. Too much of that time is spent navigating fragmented systems and administrative overhead. Our BHAG (Big Hairy Audacious Goal) is to save teachers 10+ hours every week while helping elevate their practices, so that time can go back to what matters most - teaching, learning, and meaningful time with students. Our approach is three-pronged. First, Toddle brings the entire teaching and learning lifecycle into one place. Teachers plan and map curriculum, create assessments and gradebooks, maintain student portfolios, communicate with families, and generate progress reports and transcripts - all from a single, coherent system. Toddle also supports adjacent workflows where teachers are closely involved, including attendance, timetables, calendars, accreditation, behaviour management, analytics, and insights. Second, every layer of the platform is deeply AI-powered. Educators work with a thoughtful AI partner to plan curriculum, create lessons and assessments, assist with grading, write progress report comments, and derive insights from data. Toddle also offers student-facing AI Tutors, enabling highly personalized and immersive learning experiences. Third, Toddle integrates seamlessly with the broader school technology ecosystem. The platform supports 50+ integrations across SIS platforms, content providers, data & integration platforms, and workspaces such as Google, Apple, and Microsoft. You can watch our founder and CEO’s overview of Toddle  here . Headquartered in India with a multicultural team across 20+ countries, Toddle is built by former educators and school practitioners who understand the realities of classrooms firsthand. We care deeply about craft, clarity, and reducing unnecessary complexity for teachers. People who thrive at Toddle enjoy building thoughtful systems, care about real-world impact, and are motivated by long-term change in K-12 education. Here’s what you’ll be doing We are looking for a passionate and motivated product engineer who partners with us to build intuitive, scalable, and delightful user experiences for teachers, students, and parents. As a product Engineer, you will contribute to designing, developing, and deploying high-quality product. You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, educators, and gain exposure to real-world usage in schools. This role offers hands-on ownership, continuous technical growth and product understanding in a fast-growing SaaS environment. What you’ll achieve in your first 3 months Understand the codebase, architecture, and core product workflows Build strong fundamentals in frontend and backend concepts Start contributing to feature development, production fixes & optimization What you’ll achieve in your first 6 months Independently deliver major features by writing clean, modular, and optimized code Participate in code reviews and collaborate cross-functionally What you’ll achieve in your first 12 months Own modules end-to-end, coordinating closely with Product and Support teams through scoping, design review, development, release, and post-release support Get the opportunity to work on performance, optmization and infra projects Contribute to hiring, onboarding, technical knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of engineering processes Must have Skills: Frontend Languages & Frameworks - JavaScript (ES6+) , HTML5 / CSS3, React, Redux/Apollo Client Backend Languages & Frameworks - Node.js, Express & GraphQL, PostgreSQL Tools & Platforms - Git, Build tools (Webpack), Profiling tools (React Profiler, Memory profiling), GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted development tools, Knex Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn Ability to write clean, readable, and maintainable code Good to have: Exposure to AWS ecosystem (Lambda, SQS, CloudWatch, API Gateway, etc.) Working experience in ReactNative Product mindset with empathy for end users Clear communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally Past working experience in SaaS or product based companies Is this someone that looks like you? Education: B.E/B.Tech degree Experience: 2 to 5 years of relevant working experience (SaaS preferred) post graduation. Soft Skills: Having a bias towards action, a good sense of design, empathy, and good communication skills We deeply value building the right culture at Toddle, and these are a few things that we look for in each hire – Coach-ability, Curiosity, Ownership, Hustle, and Humility Excited about the role? Here are some more benefits: 1) Flexibility at work Work from anywhere - home, co-working space, cafe or even the hills Block “no-meeting hours” to enable uninterrupted focused work 2) Exposure to diverse learning opportunities Work across different projects & teams to develop skills outside of your core expertise 3) Industry best leave policy We trust you fully on your commitment to our mission and your judgement on planning your time and taking leaves: No cap on the number of sick or casual leaves Special paid leaves for childbirth, wedding etc. Menstrual leave 4) No bell curve performance evaluations We put in a lot of work to hire the best, and therefore we don’t expect anyone to deliver less than the best! 5) And yes, a super fun and diverse group of folks to collaborate and grow with Still with us? Here’s the process: 1) Shortlisting: Complete the form on this page. We’ll check out your application and assess it for a fit. If shortlisted, you’ll hear from us within 2-3 days. 2) Interview Process: Typically, we do 2-3 rounds of interviews, a written assignment, and deep reference checks. 3) We value your time and aim to communicate proactively at all stages of your application. You can always reach out with any questions!
